categories.name: OpenServ Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokens launched on OpenServ, a multi-chain crowdfunding platform designed for autonomous startups and Agentic Applications (aApps) built on OpenServ’s AI reasoning infrastructure.

categories.name: Reserve Ecosystem
categories.content: Decentralized Token Folio (DTF) issued and created with the Reserve protocol's open-source contracts (developed by ABC Labs).

categories.name: CreatorBid Ecosystem
categories.content: CreatorBid Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via creator.bid.

categories.name: Dinari Ecosystem
categories.content: The Dinari Ecosystem comprises tokens tokenized by Dinari.

categories.name: Pons Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched on pons (https://ponsfamily.com/launchpad).

categories.name: Yield Farming
categories.content: Yield farming involves putting cryptocurrency into a DeFi protocol to collect interest on trading fees. Liquidity providers can profit by providing liquidity in DeFi protocols like Uniswap, utilizing assets that would otherwise sit idle on an exchange or hot wallet.

categories.name: Reddit Points
categories.content: Reddit Community Points are blockchain tokens that are owned and controlled by a specific Reddit community. With these point tokens, a community member can own a piece of their favorite subreddit. The points can be earned through contributions in the community such as post creation, comments, and content moderations.

categories.name: Animal Racing
categories.content: Animal racing tokens are digital tokens used in virtual animal racing games.

categories.name: Pump.fun Creator
categories.content: Pump.fun creator tokens are Solana-based memecoins tied to influencers, blending streaming culture with DeFi.

categories.name: Uniswap v4 Hooks
categories.content: Tokens of protocols whose core product is built on Uniswap v4 hooks. Hooks turn the AMM from fixed infrastructure into a programmable platform, enabling designs that were impossible in earlier versions: dynamic fees that widen during volatility, MEV-mitigation through batched uniform-clearing-price execution, rehypothecation of idle liquidity into lending markets, vault-managed concentrated liquidity issued as fungible ERC-6909 positions, limit orders implemented as single-tick positions, and lending markets that share collateral with swap liquidity. Projects in this category use hooks as the foundation of their product rather than merely trading on Uniswap.

categories.name: AI Meme
categories.content: Meme coins related or inspired by AI. They either leverage AI-powered agents, are created using AI tools, or derive their concept from AI technologies and trends.

categories.name: Liquid Staking Tokens
categories.content: Liquid staking token is a tokenized representation of staked tokens that can be traded or used in various DeFi applications.

categories.name: Capital Launchpad (Kaito)
categories.content: Capital Launchpad is a Web3 crowdfunding platform by Kaito that connects early-stage crypto projects with investors through a merit-based allocation system.

categories.name: Binance Megadrop
categories.content: Binance Megadrop is an airdrop program by Binance. It allows users to earn rewards by subscribing to BNB to Locked Products and completing tasks within their Binance Web3 Wallet.

categories.name: Bitcoin Meme
categories.content: Meme coins native to the Bitcoin network.

categories.name: Emoji-Themed
categories.content: Meme coins related to emoji.

categories.name: Binance Alpha Spotlight
categories.content: Binance Alpha is a platform within Binance Wallet that highlights promising early-stage crypto projects before they potentially list on Binance.

categories.name: Rollups-as-a-Service (RaaS)
categories.content: Rollups-as-a-Service (RaaS) streamlines the deployment and maintenance of custom application-specific rollups by offering a simplified interface including no-code deployment options.

categories.name: TokenSets Ecosystem
categories.content: Interconnected platforms and services built around TokenSets.

categories.name: Robinhood Chain Meme
categories.content: Meme coins native to Robinhood Chain.
